//Transaction
package Practice;
import java.util.*;
public class Transaction {

	public static void main(String[] args) {
		// TODO Auto-generated method stub
		Scanner sc=new Scanner(System.in);
		
		System.out.print("Enter no. of transaction: ");
		int n=sc.nextInt();
		
		int finalBalance=0;
		
		int[] arr=new int[n];
		
		System.out.print("Enter the transactions: ");
		for(int i=0; i<n; i++) {
			arr[i]=sc.nextInt();
		}
		
		for(int i=0; i<n; i++) {
			finalBalance+=arr[i];
		}
		if(finalBalance>=0) {
			System.out.print("Final Balance = "+finalBalance);
		}
		else {
			System.out.print("Overdraft!");
		}
	}

}
